title: Severity signal gating and recovery automation harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Reduce noisy pages and accelerate safe, automated recoveries during capacity and failover events by introducing a severity gating layer and a recovery automation harness. This ticket covers the design and implementation of a signal-gating service that sits between metric/trace alerts and the pager routing system. The service will apply multi-signal correlation (SLO burn rate, region-specific error spikes, circuit-breaker tripped state, ingress qps delta, and synthetic check failures), enforce hysteresis windows, and compute a severity grade (quiet/notice/urgent) which drives routing, on-call escalation, and automated mitigations. The recovery harness will expose a set of safe automated actions (adjust CB thresholds, enable regional load-shedding policy, rollback last rollout, or trigger warm pool scaling) as idempotent runbook steps that can be executed automatically for graded severity or manually from the console. Key goals: reduce actionable pages by 55%+ for transient infra noise, keep mean time to recovery steady or improved, and ensure no automatic action increases customer error budgets beyond an agreed rollback threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Severity gating service deployed behind feature flag and ingesting alerts from Alertmanager and synthetic monitor topics
Signal correlation reduces duplicate pages by at least 55% in the staging traffic replay test
Automated recovery actions executed in canary mode with safety checks (SLO guardrails, manual approval for high-severity) and full audit logging
Runbook templates available in Console with one-click manual execute and a documented rollback path
Diagnostics dashboard shows per-region SLO burn, CB state, gating decisions, and action history
Playbook tests (simulated network partition and cold-start surge) have deterministic outcomes and documented postmortem notes
tasks: Spec: define gating rules, signal weights, hysteresis and severity mapping (owner: A. Patel)
Integration: wire Alertmanager, synthetic checks, and CB telemetry into gating service (owner: G. Huang)
Runbook API: implement idempotent step primitives and RBAC for automated actions
Console: add UI for severity logs, manual runbook execution and override
Testing: create staging traffic replay scenarios and evaluate false positive/negative rates
Rollout: gradual canary behind feature flag then org-wide enable with audit retention
